title: Objects of the source of a morphism of sites are covered by images
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a morphism of sites every object of the source site admits a covering whose members map into the image of an object of the target site (statement lines 3101-3108). The proof is a short but complete argument: exactness of the pullback shows that the pullback of the final object is the final object (proof lines 3111-3113); the pullback is the sheafification of the left Kan extension of the final presheaf, so there is a covering on whose members that left Kan extension has a section (proof lines 3114-3115); and since its values are colimits indexed by morphisms from the object into images of objects, such a morphism exists (proof lines 3116-3118). The non-formal content is the passage from a section of a colimit to one of its terms. The claim is H1: a short argument with each input named.
